title: L5 Security Agent #8682 — autonomous delivery
description: 16 Security stories in four engine waves: foundation, lifecycle, assessments/clients, then one coordinated release and live qualification. Gateway/frontend auto-deploys do not gate code. Optional planned file groups explain work; they never restrict agent changes. Initial trigger only; all wave evaluations are machine-driven.

epic_metadata.title: Product Security Agent
epic_metadata.description: Shared L5 services configuration, event-driven threat modeling and static code review, findings and Product Context reuse; UI, CLI and MCP.

wave_metadata.title: Shared foundation
wave_metadata.description: Contracts → Product access → configuration → admission → durable execution. Reviewed merges and offline tests; no deployment barrier.

wave_metadata.title: Lifecycle and release preparation
wave_metadata.description: Bindings, triggers, findings and release tooling can develop concurrently. Build the release path; defer L5 publication.

wave_metadata.title: Assessments and clients
wave_metadata.description: Threat modeling, static review, UI, CLI and MCP; Context publication follows the two adapters and findings API.

wave_metadata.title: One release and live qualification
wave_metadata.description: Build SA16 harness, then SA15 releases the combined candidate and retains ownership through real assessments, all clients, recovery and cleanup. Logical waves 4 and 5 share this engine wave.
